## Design

### 2026-10-20 – # Starting Maestro Mini

**2h**

# Starting Maestro Mini
This device is going to be a tool/loop synth. It will have different utility options, which will be rotated by a Control push button. To be fair, I am still in the process of finalizing the design, but I have still made some progress so far. Again, whatever I have here for the design or schematics might change in the future.
## What I did
- Researched what components I would need. Since I plan to use the XIAO ESP32 C3 once again for this project, and I need around 10 pushbuttons, I will use MCP23017, a 16bit I/O port expander.
- As of now, I created the repository for this week's project and started on the schematic using KiCad. For now, I have the MCP23017 and the 10 pushbuttons in place and connected with the necessary resistors.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/s5X6uAidfBv2Me3zVHdgxREVUKqtvsIM/787f249301917e91867f599039a947ef16f3aa324e5b4ee8e53168b322e3006d.png)

## What I will do next
- Add and connect the ESP32, the OLED screen, and other components.

### 2026-10-24 – # #Lock In

**7h**

# #Lock In
I've been pretty busy this week with school, forcing me to work on this project today and tomorrow... and it was so rough :(

# What I did
- I finished the schematics for the project. This actually took me a long time, in which I had to figure out where everything connects (such great help Google and Gemini have been). I got so many errors, for example, at some point it says that there was a short circuit that could happen. I tried finding where that stubborn wire was, but the problem was that I put the PWR_FLAG a s mere label rather than an actual component xd

![Untitled drawing 12](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/s5X6uAidfBv2Me3zVHdgxREVUKqtvsIM/4970efb0b89f2dcb51d68304c2c2d15eb932d076c025e27124a04e5682608517.png)
- I had trouble finding footprints for some of my components, for example the Adafruit PAM8302... Without the proper footprint, it took me a while to figure out how it should be oriented in the PCB editor. By looking at images of the component, I realized that my wiring was wrong, so I had to fix that.

![Untitled drawing 14](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/s5X6uAidfBv2Me3zVHdgxREVUKqtvsIM/ec1711a4f45641c000212babd69d482bf8aed3b87db40b747ba0d4d5e5637307.png)
